# Prague.bio

> Prague.bio, z.s. is a Czech association founded in 2023 that unites key players of the life sciences sector in the Czech Republic – companies, startups, research institutions, investors and public bodies – and promotes the Czech biotech ecosystem in Central Europe and abroad.

## Key facts

- Mission: position Prague and the Czech Republic as a leading biotechnology hub in Central Europe; one unified voice of the Czech biotech sector.
- Czech biotech in numbers: 427 biotech entities, 32,000 employees in the life sciences sector, 12,000 students in biology, biochemistry and chemistry.
- Members: the association currently has 54 members, from large pharmaceutical companies and startups to R&D institutions and government bodies.
- Prague.bio Conference 2026 (4th edition): 23 September 2026, National House Vinohrady, Náměstí Míru 820/9, 120 00 Prague.
- Executive Academy: four-month program for scientists who want to run technology companies; October 2026 – February 2027, 8 meetings in Prague, 12 participants, fee 12.000 CZK.
- Contact: info@prague.bio · Gen. Píky 430/26, 160 00 Praha 6, Czech Republic.

## Pages

- [About us](https://prague.bio/about-us.html): Prague.bio was founded in 2023 with the vision of uniting key players in the life sciences sector in the Czech Republic.
- [Academy](https://prague.bio/academy.html): Two ways to start in biotech: Prague.bio Executive Academy for future managers of biotech start-ups, and Life Science Transfer Academy for researchers with an idea.
- [Biotech in Czechia](https://prague.bio/biotech-in-cz.html): The Czech Republic has significant scientific potential, and biotechnology is one of the most promising fields which importance will only grow in the future.
- [Prague.bio Conference 2023](https://prague.bio/conference-2023.html): First edition took place on 26 September 2023 with 150 participants coming.
- [Prague.bio Conference 2024](https://prague.bio/conference-2024.html): Second edition took place on 24 September 2024 and attracted 300 attendees.
- [Prague.bio Conference 2025](https://prague.bio/conference-2025.html): Photo gallery from the third edition of Prague.bio Conference, 25 September 2025.
- [Prague.bio Conference 2026](https://prague.bio/conference-2026-gallery.html): Photo gallery from the fourth edition of Prague.bio Conference, 23 September 2026.
- [Prague.bio Conference 2026](https://prague.bio/conference.html): Fourth edition of Prague.bio Conference, 23 September 2026, National House Vinohrady, Prague. 400+ participants, 20+ speakers, pitch session and partnering.
- [Contact](https://prague.bio/contact.html): Get in touch with Prague.bio: contact form, e-mail info@prague.bio and office address in Prague 6.
- [Prague.bio](https://prague.bio/): Prague.bio connects biotech companies, startups, research and investors to grow the Czech and Central European life sciences ecosystem.
- [Our members](https://prague.bio/members.html): Prague.bio unites biotech companies, startups, research institutes and partners within the Czech biotech ecosystem.
- [Membership](https://prague.bio/membership.html): Prague.bio gathers and connects key players in the life sciences sector in the Czech Republic and the region of Central Europe.
- [News & Events](https://prague.bio/news-events.html): News, interviews and press releases from Prague.bio and the Czech biotech ecosystem.
- [Register your project](https://prague.bio/register-your-project.html): Register your project for the pitch and poster session of Prague.bio Conference 2026.
